gates.description: Hara owns a headless workspace.* state, event, view and effect contract.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara#383 introduced workspace.*, #384 synchronized runtime mirrors and conformance paths, and #385 restored the complete release/archive validation. The pinned Hara revision retains that boundary.

gates.description: Hara web-* packages remain product-neutral, include a neutral add-on lifecycle and expose document migration compatibility without depending on Hodos.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara-ui#9 established the neutral web service and add-on packages. #10 preserves the existing greenways.rich-text/2, editor and Hestia entry points as compatibility exports, adds an inert hodos.2d/document migration descriptor, documents the consumer path and verifies that Hara UI has no static or dynamic Hodos import. The merged Hara UI revision is pinned.

gates.description: Hodos connects HAL-shaped Workspace models to trusted packaged UI factories, responsive shell mechanics and reusable 2D document projection.
gates.evidence: greenways-ai/hodos#24-#31 established the trusted Dev component line and #32 added the recursive responsive Workspace shell. #33 added validated hodos.2d/document and hodos.2d/graph models. #34 adds the product-neutral safe Document DOM host, the explicit legacy Hara document projector and deterministic artefact-renderer/listener lifecycle. It also repairs the root test command so packages/2d and packages/2d-ui suites are always executed. The exact merged Hodos revision passed the complete package, test, demo and site gate and is pinned.

gates.description: Playground is the reference workspace.edn-driven Hodos shell consumer while retaining Hara runtime and application policy authority.
gates.evidence: hara-lang/hara-playground#29-#38 progressively mounted Preview, Editor, REPL, Value Inspector, Problems, Explorer and Catalog through Hodos. #39 replaced the active fixed desktop/mobile layout controller with the recursive Hodos shell, evaluated workspace.edn through Hara and preserved Playground product authority. #40 removed the inactive competing layout model/controller, made every featured sample a complete explicit workspace.edn project, and documented the delivered Hara → Playground → Hodos authority chain. The exact #40 revision passed all 203 Node tests, architecture/check scripts, production build, checksum-verified runtime installation, isolated Chromium Audio validation and the complete Supersonic manifest/browser workflow. A first hodos.2d/document consumer remains the next bounded slice.

gates.description: Existing Hodos Worlds source, renderer and viewer contracts remain compatible during the broader reorganisation.
gates.evidence: The pinned Hodos revision keeps Core independent and retains replaceable source, renderer and viewer packages while adding Dev, Workspace shell and 2D components above them. The complete Hodos package, Worlds, demo and site gates passed after the Document DOM host and 2D test-gate repair.

gates.description: Greenways OS retains installation, keyring, consent and privileged capability authority outside Hodos.
gates.evidence: The pinned Greenways OS baseline verifies installed app identity and keeps raw key material out of application surfaces.

gates.description: A Hodos keyring connector requests typed operations without receiving credentials or private keys.
Supersonic is an optional Hodos Audio connector rather than an inseparable neutral Hara runtime feature.
gates.evidence: Tracked by greenways-ai/hodos#22 and the later Hara runtime profile split. The pinned Playground browser gate proves the current Supersonic project remains compatible while this ownership split is still pending.
